=='''Overview'''==
'''Blossom''' is a {{Rarity|Rare}} unit. She is only obtainable through [[Summon|summons]]. Upon deployment, she buffs the damage of units within her range. She also heals/adds the base HP every wave.

==Stats Overview==
{{Tower_Infobox
|skin3=Summer Skin
|image3=Sakuro Summer (Pose).png
|caption1= "I love you, [[Shinobi|Shinobi]]!"
|caption2= "All I've been doing is watching you two, [[Fox Ninja|Fox Ninja]] and [[Sosuke|Shinobi]], from behind... now get a good look at my back!"
}}{{Main Stats}}
Note that her buff doesn't stack with [[Idol (Star)|Idol]]'s.

Her buff also stacks with [[Commander]] making the Physical buff reach up to 35% - 110%.

==Selling==
Units sell for 25% of the sum of their deployment cost and upgrades.

==Trivia==
* On Update 9.0.0, she used to heal 25 HP of tower HP per wave (stacks each unit), now she heals 3%-5% each wave (stacks each unit).
* As of Update 12.5.0, she, [[Idol (Star)]] and [[Skeleton (Soul King)]] are the only ones capable of buffing both Physical and Magical damage.
** She's the only character that can still be obtained as of now.
* Before Update 4.0, she was a ground unit, meaning she could not be deployed on hill areas.
* Before Update ???, her damage buff was 5% instead of 10%.
